editorial:
Imagine you are babysitting your young cousins and accidentally stumble upon a book that sucks you into a world of magic. That is exactly what happens to Sofia, Júlia, and Lucas. They end up in the Magic Forest, a place where classic storybook characters like Pinocchio and Little Red Riding Hood actually live. The whole vibe is bright, colorful, and feels like a giant playground. It is the kind of movie that makes you feel like a kid again, with plenty of wonder and silly moments as the group tries to figure out how to get home.

What really stands out is how the movie plays with the original fairy tales. You get to see what happens when real-world people mess up a famous story, which adds a funny twist to the adventure. While the special effects are a bit dated, the energy stays high and the pacing is quick enough to keep you interested. If you have kids or just want something lighthearted, this is a great pick.
endingExplained: After causing a lot of chaos in the Magic Forest, the group realizes they have to fix the stories they broke to get home. With some help and a bit of bravery, they set things right and find the way back to the real world. Sofia and the kids return to the house just in time. They learn a big lesson about responsibility and friendship, ending the movie on a happy, warm note for everyone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves magic and family adventures
